server.name: io.github.github/github-mcp-server
server.title: GitHub
server.description: Work with repositories, issues, pull requests and Actions on GitHub.

ai.kontour.station/curation.summary: Endpoint and version match the official MCP Registry entry. Its authorization server (github.com/login/oauth) has no dynamic client registration, so sign-in needs an OAuth app you register with GitHub. A personal access token header also works with GitHub, but Station cannot store one for a remote server yet.

server.name: ai.kontour.station/gmail
server.title: Gmail
server.description: Search and read Gmail threads. Drafting needs the gmail.compose scope; labeling needs gmail.modify.

ai.kontour.station/curation.summary: Google lists this endpoint as Developer Preview and has not published it to the official MCP Registry, so Station names it in its own namespace. Its authorization server (accounts.google.com) has no dynamic client registration: bring your own Google Cloud OAuth client. gmail.readonly covers search and read; drafting needs gmail.compose and labeling needs gmail.modify. Google's tool list has no send tool. Email is content written by others, so in Station-engine sessions Station asks before tools that send or change things by default; you can change that per tool.
